expectations.text: MD034 is correctly described as flagging bare URLs (URLs NOT wrapped in angle brackets)
expectations.evidence: Section 'What is MD034?' (line 22-32) clearly states: 'MD034 flags any URL that appears "bare" in the markdown text — meaning it is written as a plain URL without being wrapped in angle brackets `<>` or formatted as a proper markdown link `[text](url)`'

expectations.text: The fix described is to wrap URLs in angle brackets <> or use [text](url) format
expectations.evidence: Section 'How to Fix MD034' (lines 40-56) explicitly describes both options: 'Option 1 — Wrap in angle brackets' and 'Option 2 — Use a named markdown link', with code examples for both approaches

expectations.text: Both URLs in the content are identified as violating MD034
expectations.evidence: Section 'Why MD034 Triggers' (lines 34-38) explicitly lists both URLs: '`https://github.com/example/repo` → bare URL (no wrapping)' and '`https://docs.example.com/guide` → bare URL (no wrapping)'. Additionally, the 'Lint Results' section (lines 14-20) shows two MD034 errors on lines 1 and 3 for each URL
